status: Design proposal only; not approved or integrated.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, stylized-concept.
Create a polished VISUAL DESIGN PROPOSAL BOARD for seven collectible achievement badges for a Japanese elementary-school beach cleanup pet game. This is a proposal image, not code. Wide landscape composition, 1536x1024 or larger at same ratio. Beautiful light warm ivory paper background, generous margins, orderly 4-column 2-row grid of eight rounded pale cards. Top header in clear rounded Japanese typography exactly "うみの たからものバッジ". Small subtitle exactly "しょうごう デザイン案". Each badge is the large central focus in its card, with a readable Japanese title directly beneath on paper (NOT tiny letters inside badge artwork).
Style: very cute premium collectible sticker / softly domed enamel pin illustration, rounded kid-friendly proportions, joyful forms, thick smooth warm-ivory rim, restrained fine colored outlines, turquoise/mint/coral/lavender/lemon palette, small glossy pearly highlights. Saturated focal motifs readable at phone size. Soft painted volume, no photoreal metal, no intricate micro-detail, no huge crowns/diamonds/fantasy clutter. Each badge has its OWN DISTINCT SILHOUETTE and color; NOT seven identical gold circular medals. Consistent craftsmanship and scale. No existing copyrighted mascots.
Cards ordered left to right:
1. Name exactly "はじめのいっぽ賞". Badge: peach-pink scallop shell silhouette with ivory rim, two tiny friendly barefoot footprints pressed in pale golden sand and a small turquoise wave along bottom. Welcoming starter collectible.
2. Name exactly "プラごみハンター賞". Badge: rounded turquoise shield, a little recycling collection net holding a single simple pastel plastic bottle, tiny bright coral sparkle. Clearly gathering litter, NOT archery or weapons.
3. Name exactly "うみはかせ賞". Badge: lavender open book silhouette with ivory rim, a small friendly aqua dolphin face peeking over the book wearing a tiny navy graduation cap. Simple big eyes, white underside, peach cheeks. Cute scholarship, no text on book.
4. Name exactly "クイズまんてん賞". Badge: bright lemon-yellow rounded five-point star, tiny friendly smile, a prominent coral '100' on its center, little mint ribbon tails at bottom. Most cheerful high contrast achievement, minimal detail.
5. Name exactly "ゴミたんてい賞". Badge: oversized friendly mint magnifying-glass silhouette with coral handle, a tiny striped seashell and small bottle silhouette visible in the pale blue lens; one pearly white sparkle. Clear discovery/detective theme.
6. Name exactly "ひろいもの名人賞". Badge: a coral-and-ivory rosette ribbon, central aqua beach-cleanup grabber lifting a little pastel wrapper, small gold star above. Rounded safe friendly object shapes, no claws or sharp instruments. Feels skillful and celebratory.
7. Name exactly "そだておや賞". Badge: mint heart silhouette in a warm ivory scalloped frame, tiny peach heart held gently by two simple rounded flippers with a small aqua dolphin and pale mint turtle smiling together. Warm affectionate companion-care design, readable and not crowded.
8. A UI state sample, NOT an eighth badge. Title exactly "あと すこし！". Show the same shell-footprint badge as card1 in very pale translucent pastel outline, still cute and recognizable, small dotted border around it, beneath it a small friendly aqua progress bar. Caption exactly "できたら いろが つくよ". No padlock, no grim gray silhouette.
Bottom footnote in small readable Japanese exactly "なまえ・もらえる条件はそのまま。見た目をたのしく。"
All Japanese text accurately spelled, legible rounded sans. No extra English, no watermarks, no phone bezels. Equal card spacing, generous breathing room. Badge artwork should occupy about 65% of each card's width with distinct beautiful silhouettes; exact seven current title names are essential.
